title: Tile Mutator Audit - Classification of XODR Tile Mutation Operations
scope: All mutating operations on XODR tiles in the ultimate_pipeline tiling subsystem

classification_criteria.PRE_FREEZE_REPAIR: Must run BEFORE TILESET_FROZEN. Mutates tile XODRs. Safe to run multiple times during tile production. Examples: S-invariant repair, planView seam repair, laneSection successor repair, negative-s repair, lane link scrubbing, negative-s repair.
classification_criteria.READ_ONLY_VALIDATOR: Never mutates tiles. Runs anytime (before or after freeze). Pure validation/read-only. Examples: tile_validator, tile_equivalence assertions, tile_metadata generation, tile_manifest generation.
classification_criteria.FORBIDDEN_POST_FREEZE_MUTATOR: Must NEVER run after TILESET_FROZEN. If run post-freeze, invalidates tileset integrity. Examples: any ad-hoc script that writes XODR after manifest publication.

mutators.name: S-invariant repair (negative-s repair)
mutators.description: Repairs negative s-values in planView geometry. Mutates planView geometry s/length attributes.

mutators.name: PlanView seam repair
mutators.description: Repairs elevation discontinuities at planView geometry boundaries. Mutates planView geometry and elevationProfile.

mutators.name: Lane section successor/predecessor repair
mutators.description: Repairs missing lane successor/predecessor links in lane/link. Adds missing link elements.

mutators.name: Negative-s geometry repair
mutators.description: Fixes negative s coordinates in planView geometry by applying offset.

mutators.name: Lane link scrubbing (_drop_links_outside_tile)
mutators.description: Removes lane links pointing to roads outside the tile boundary. Only runs when allow_successor_outside_tile=False.

mutators.name: External link scrubbing (_scrub_external_links)
mutators.description: Removes road/lane links pointing to roads/junctions not included in the runtime tile. Runs during runtime tile construction.

mutators.name: Global driving lane marking (_mark_global_driving_lanes)
mutators.description: Sets was_driving=true on all driving lanes in the SOURCE root (not tile). Used for semantic preservation.

mutators.name: Tile extraction (_build_tile_root + _finalize_tile)
mutators.description: Creates tile XODRs by deep-cloning roads from source. Applies buffer, drops external links if configured. This IS the tile creation step.

mutators.name: Runtime tile builder (_build_tile_root + _scrub_external_links)
mutators.description: Builds standalone runtime tiles with local rebasing, junction closure, and link scrubbing. Creates runtime XODR tiles.
mutates: Creates new runtime tile XODR files

mutators.name: S-invariant repair (pipeline stage 08)
mutators.description: Pipeline stage 08 runs multiple repairs: s-invariant, lane successor, degenerate lane, z-seam, island quarantine.

mutators.name: XODR sanitizer (_fix_links)
mutators.description: Removes redundant/self lane links and junction connections.

mutators.name: Elevation link offset solver
mutators.description: Solves and applies elevation link offsets for lane continuity.

mutators.name: Elevation profile builder
mutators.description: Builds elevation profiles for lanes.

mutators.name: Mesh continuity repairer
mutators.description: Repairs mesh continuity in XODR.

mutators.name: Road net converter (osm_to_xodr)
mutators.description: Converts OSM to initial XODR (before any tiling). This is the SOURCE generation, not tile mutation.

mutators.name: Deterministic alignment
mutators.description: Aligns XODR to target CRS/projection. Mutates header offset and potentially planView.

mutators.name: Geo alignment
mutators.description: Aligns XODR to geographic projection. Mutates header and planView.

mutators.name: Autofix post-prune elevation
mutators.description: Auto-fixes elevation after pruning.

mutators.name: Tile validator (CARLA load)
mutators.description: Loads tile in CARLA and checks waypoints/spawn. Does NOT mutate tiles. Diagnostic only.

mutators.name: Tile equivalence / assertions
mutators.description: Read-only assertions on tile sets. Computes ownership, checks duplicates, verifies adjacency. Never mutates.

mutators.name: Tile metadata generation
mutators.description: Generates tile_metadata.json and tile_manifest.json from existing tiles. Read-only.

mutators.name: Tile forensics / diagnostics
mutators.description: Diagnostic analysis of tile set. Does not mutate (optionally writes reports).

mutators.name: Tile auto forensics
mutators.description: Auto-diagnostics for tile set. Explicitly documents 'NO automatic repair'.

mutators.name: Tile matcher / duplicate assertion
mutators.description: Matches tiles across runs for equivalence checking. Read-only.

mutators.name: Tile adjacency verification
mutators.description: Verifies tile adjacency graph. Read-only.

mutators.name: Stage digest generator
mutators.description: Generates SHA256 hashes of stage artifacts. Read-only.

mutators.name: Collision/LOD policy check
mutators.description: Checks OBJ objects against XODR road corridors. Read-only.

mutators.name: Blender runner (FBX conversion)
mutators.classification: PRE_FREEZE_REPAIR (for FBX artifacts, not XODR tiles)
mutators.description: Converts OBJ to FBX via Blender. Produces FBX artifacts, not XODR tiles.

mutators.name: OSM2World runner
mutators.description: Runs OSM2World to generate OBJ/GLB from OSM. Produces visual artifacts, not XODR tiles.

mutators.name: S-invariant repair (worker --fix-s)
mutators.description: CLI tool to repair negative-s geometry. Can be run standalone.

tileset_freeze_implications.freeze_point: After ALL PRE_FREEZE_REPAIR operations complete, BEFORE any READ_ONLY_VALIDATOR generates metadata/manifest
forbidden_after_freeze: Any operation that writes .xodr files to the tiles directory
Any operation that modifies planView/geometry, lane/link, elevationProfile, header/offset
Any ad-hoc script that rewrites tile XODRs
allowed_after_freeze: READ_ONLY_VALIDATOR operations (metadata, manifest, validation, equivalence checks)
Reading tiles for downstream processing (FBX generation, collision check, etc.)
tileset_freeze_implications.invalidation_trigger: If any FORBIDDEN_POST_FREEZE_MUTATOR runs after freeze, the tileset MUST be invalidated, rebuilt from source, and re-frozen.
